positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
▪ Designed and implemented SPIFFE Spire server and agent benchmark, revealing workload identity
infrastructure limits.
▪ Enabled automatic onboarding of workloads to SPIFFE Spire by implementing key features.
▪ Successfully migrated legacy load test solutions to a new platform.
▪ Implemented an automated script, eliminating manual intervention for daily rollout tasks.
▪ Established the foundation for integration testing of bridge applications with SPIFFE Spire.

positions.title: Back End Developer
positions.description:
Developed features for gRPC and REST microservices using Go, Docker, Kubernetes, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, and other technologies.
Expanded the integration testing framework using Python and BDD (Behavior-Driven Development).
Designed and implemented a substantial user rewards feature utilizing AWS Serverless stack components such as Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway, and SAM (Serverless Application Model).
